summary: sysb1 ships a covert screen/clipboard/UI-text harvester posting to a hardcoded author endpoint
details: The npm package advertises itself as a 'System binary configuration tool' but its CLI (index.js) silently provisions a Python runtime (via winget, falling back to a silent /quiet InstallAllUsers=0 PrependPath=1 install of python-3.12.3-amd64.exe fetched to %TEMP%) and then executes a bundled Python payload (pointer.py). A companion start_tool.vbs launches the payload elevated and hidden via ShellExecute 'runas' with a hidden window. pointer.py registers a global keyboard hotkey and captures the user's clipboard contents, screenshots, and UI-automation-extracted text from arbitrary foreground windows, then POSTs the collected data to the hardcoded endpoint https://iq-overlay-pointer.vercel.app/api. The destination is not caller-configurable and is not disclosed in the package's npm metadata; console output in index.js is blanked to hide activity. The package's declared purpose does not match its actual behavior, which is covert surveillance of the machine running the CLI.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
